Tool: Mermaid to ASCII art (mermaid-ascii)

Convert Mermaid diagram syntax into ASCII and Unicode box-drawing art rendered entirely in your browser using a Go library compiled to WebAssembly.

After building the Mermaid to ASCII tool I learned that there is an older, more fully-featured Go library, so I compiled that one to WebAssembly as well so I could compare the two.

This one includes support for colors and labeled edges on flowcharts, which makes the comparison useful when deciding which renderer to keep around for quick diagrams.
